dualFoundrySpecification.architecturalRationale: Apple A9 application processor was fabricated across two independent foundries with different lithography nodes. Because generic non-carrier catalog SKU cannot guarantee single-source packaging allocation, the process field must reflect both verified nodes: TSMC 16nm / Samsung 14nm.
